IronSourceSdk.updateMessage: LevelPlay SDK 9.6.0 update: a new version of the LevelPlay SDK is now available. Update your Unity package from Package Manager (Ads Mediation UPM Package) or from the LevelPlay Network Manager (UPM or Unity Plugin). For more info about improvements in this release and to get started, please visit the changelog and documentation: https://docs.unity.com/grow/levelplay/sdk/unity/changelog/ https://docs.unity.com/grow/levelplay/sdk/unity/get-started/

9.6.0.message: LevelPlay SDK 9.6.0 update: a new version is now available, and includes a streamlined API, improved clarity, and removal of deprecated components for a smoother developer experience. To update your Unity package and SDK to the latest, please follow this guide: https://developers.is.com/ironsource-mobile/unity/unity-plugin/unity-package-migration-9-0-0/
